node.title: Classify every K'=11 rank-eight chart by one fixed circuit
node.closure: codimension-one factorization through nine-point evaluation and exact circuit-shadow matroid counting
node.statement: At K'=11, every fixed rank-eight nine-coordinate component chart in the ten-dimensional correction hyperplane has one fixed circuit C_B of size 2<=c<=9. Circuit size one would turn a fixed-chart coordinate equation into a forbidden residual global-common-support coordinate. Every extending eleven-set has exactly C(11-c,2) rank-eight nine-shadows, 55-C(11-c,2) rank-nine nine-shadows, and c rank-ten bases, while the locator ideal L_(C_B)RS_{<11-c} lies in V'. Every c=2,...,9 is realizable under the local linear-algebra hypotheses, so the next proof must use global incidence or chronology information.
